MetalSharp DXMT runtime build artifacts

Source commit: a24464357fc0cb09ba794330d89d7dd6df9e2140 (vendored)
Source path: vendor/dxmt
Build command:
  PATH="<xcrun-shim-dir>:$PATH" \
  MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0 \
  METALSHARP_X86_LLVM_ROOT=<dir containing clang+llvm-15.0.7-x86_64-apple-darwin21.0> \
  METALSHARP_WINE_ROOT=<MetalSharp Wine 11.5 install prefix> \
  tools/d3d12-metal-sdk/scripts/prepare-dxmt-x86-llvm15.sh
  (win32 lane: meson setup build-metalsharp-x86 --cross-file build-win32.txt
   with the same LLVM/Wine roots)

Rebuilt 2026-08-15 targeting macOS 14.0 minimum / Metal 3:
- Metal shaders compiled with the Xcode 16.0 toolchain (metalfe-32023.335)
  pinned to -target air64-apple-macos14.0 (see vendor/dxmt/meson.build), so
  the embedded AIR is air64-apple-macosx14.0.0 instead of Metal 4
  (air64_v29/macosx27) produced by the macOS 26/27 toolchains.
- Native winemetal.so linked with MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0
  (LC_BUILD_VERSION minos 14.0; previously minos 26.0/27.0).
- x86_64 LLVM 15.0.7: prebuilt clang+llvm-15.0.7-x86_64-apple-darwin21.0.
- Wine: MetalSharp Wine 11.5 install prefix (-Dwine_install_path).

Published as metalsharp-graphics-dll.tar.zst (Graphics/dll/dxmt lane),
sha256 d0b30d54e785c1476b4ad626c83fbf81b84b533d134adc2e38c2f31d6ad66801,
on the `bundles` release.
